messages.subject: Error running large model
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to fit a multiple outcome model (3 response variables) with both fixed and random effects. For each of the outcomes the there are two random effects (model = 'generic') associated with a sparse precision matrix (dimension 12500 x 12500). As such, there would be approximately 12500*6 random effects to estimate (BLUPs). After running for a while I got the following error:

taucs_calloc_stub fail to calloc 84100 elements of size 8 bytes

        Reason    : Alloc failed
        Message   : GSL-library call returned NULL-pointer
        Function  : GMRFLib_init_density
        File      : density.c
        Line      : 759

        Function  : GMRFLib_init_density

        GitID     : file: density.c  1f6a39183ef43d8ef33f10ff3f04fd13f8432758 - Mon Feb 22 21:27:50 2021 +0300

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

My session info is:

R version 4.1.0 (2021-05-18)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)
Running under: Windows 10 x64 (build 22000)

Matrix products: default

Is the error because the number of effects to estimate is very large or something else? I'd appreciate any help.

Kind regards,

Napo

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error running large model
parts:
try adding

library(INLA)
inla.setOption(inla.mode="experimental")

do you have access to a machine with more RAM ?
